title: XZ Utils, read like a tree

specimen.note: Fifteen years of mostly thin rings grown by one main contributor, then a sudden thickening from 2022, much of it translations. A second long ray starts in 2022 Q2 and stops in 2024 Q1, the quarter of the 5.6.0 release. The next ring is the widest in the trunk: the backdoor removal and the clean-up that followed.

epilogue: Seventy-seven quarterly rings. The figure records only what the repository records: who committed, when, and which lines changed. The backdoor note quotes the project's own commit message for e93e13c.
